messages.subject: categorical(softmax) has a memory leak
parts:
I saw an earlier thread which suggested this is a known issue but was being corrected in Version 2.0.  However, the error still appears to be there.  When you run a model, memory usage increases until the computer runs out of memory.  I am running Windows with Stan 2.1.

I tried using categorical_logit and this clears the problem but I would like to use softmax in other settings as well.

Thanks,

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] categorical(softmax) has a memory leak
parts:
On Jun 10, 2014, at 1:43 PM, Herra Huu <heikki.uu...@gmail.com> wrote:

> Has this problem been fixed in version 2.3.0? If not, here is a simple example of the model with memory leak (R code including the data generation + Stan model).

Thanks for the example.

I just verified that Herra Huu's model

* leaks in RStan 2.2.0 (over 4GB at 2K iterations), but

* is fine on the develop branch for CmdStan (under 5MB
at 2K iterations!).

We should make sure the RStan 2.3.0 release candidate doesn't
leak. It shouldn't --- if there was a function leak, that'd be
in the Stan C++ code that is called by both CmdStan and RStan.

- Bob

P.S. As an aside, for a real model, you almost certainly
don't want to do this:

data {
int<lower=1,upper=K> y[N_obs];
...

model {
for (n in 1:N_obs)
y ~ categorical_logit(beta);
...

which uses each of the N_obs data items N_obs times due to vectorization.
I would've expected this:

for (n in 1:N_obs)
y[n] ~ categorical_logit(beta);
